title.es: Pistas de lo que ocurrió antes

es: Reconocer si una causa anterior ya estaba terminada (had + participio) o venía ocurriendo hasta ese momento (had been + -ing).

teaching.en: Leo's shoes were muddy because he had been playing football in the rain.
teaching.es: Los zapatos de Leo estaban embarrados porque había estado jugando al fútbol bajo la lluvia.
teaching.explanationEs: Had been + -ing: la actividad venía ocurriendo hasta ese momento y dejó una huella.
segments: Leo's shoes were muddy because he had
been playing football in the rain.
teaching.audioText: Leo's shoes were muddy because he had been playing football in the rain.

teaching.en: The kitchen smelled of smoke because Dad had burnt the toast.
teaching.es: La cocina olía a humo porque papá había quemado la tostada.
teaching.explanationEs: Had + participio: un hecho terminado antes; vemos su resultado ahora.
segments: The kitchen smelled of smoke because
Dad had burnt the toast.
teaching.audioText: The kitchen smelled of smoke because Dad had burnt the toast.

teaching.en: Carlos was exhausted because he had been studying since six.
teaching.es: Carlos estaba agotado porque llevaba estudiando desde las seis.
teaching.explanationEs: Since six marca desde cuándo venía estudiando: es una pista de had been + -ing.
segments: Carlos was exhausted because he
had been studying since six.
teaching.audioText: Carlos was exhausted because he had been studying since six.

teaching.en: The floor was wet because Mia had spilled her juice.
teaching.es: El suelo estaba mojado porque Mia había derramado su zumo.
teaching.explanationEs: Un solo hecho cerrado: no importa cuánto duró, por eso va had spilled.
segments: The floor was wet because
Mia had spilled her juice.
teaching.audioText: The floor was wet because Mia had spilled her juice.

teaching.en: Earlier, Sara had been running for ten minutes, so she was out of breath.
teaching.es: Antes, Sara había estado corriendo diez minutos, así que estaba sin aliento.
teaching.explanationEs: For ten minutes mide la duración de la actividad anterior: had been running.
segments: Earlier, Sara had been running for ten
minutes, so she was out of breath.
teaching.audioText: Earlier, Sara had been running for ten minutes, so she was out of breath.

prompt.es: ¿Cuál frase presenta una actividad que venía ocurriendo hasta ese momento?

choices.text: Sara had run home before I saw her.
Sara ran home when I saw her.
Sara had been running when I saw her.

feedback.es: Had been running presenta una carrera que seguía en marcha; had run cierra el hecho antes y ran lo pone al mismo tiempo.

hint.es: Piensa en cuál acción estaba todavía en marcha cuando ocurrió lo otro.

prompt.es: Completa: «Los ojos de Mia estaban rojos porque había estado llorando.»

answer.text: been

feedback.es: Had been + -ing forma la actividad anterior: entre had y crying falta la palabra been.

hint.es: Entre had y el verbo en -ing va la palabra que enlaza las dos partes.

origin.text: Mia's eyes were red because she had ___ crying.

prompt.es: ¿Qué causa anterior explica el olor a humo?

choices.text: Someone had burnt the dinner.
Someone had been sleeping in the room.
Someone had opened the window.

feedback.es: Un hecho terminado antes, como quemar la cena, explica el humo; dormir o abrir la ventana no producen ese olor.

hint.es: La causa ocurrió antes de que Ana abriera la puerta.

origin.text: Ana opened the door. The room smelled of smoke.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Leo había estado jugando al fútbol toda la mañana.»

answer.text: Leo had been playing football all morning

feedback.es: Had been + playing va justo después del sujeto y all morning cierra la frase con la duración.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige por qué estaba mojado el suelo.

choices.text: His sister had been washing the floor.
His sister had spilled a drink.
His sister had been swimming in it.

feedback.es: El audio dice que su hermana había derramado su zumo: un hecho terminado que explica el suelo mojado.

origin.audio: When I got home, the floor was wet. My sister had spilled her juice.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada escena con su causa anterior.

feedback.es: Cada escena tiene huella propia: manos sucias de arreglar, pelo mojado de nadar y pastel negro de quemarlo.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase presenta una actividad que duró hasta el momento pasado?

choices.text: Tom was tired because he had missed his breakfast.
Tom was tired because he has been waiting for an hour.
Tom was tired because he had been waiting for an hour.

feedback.es: Had been waiting + for an hour mide una espera que duró hasta ese momento; had missed es un hecho cerrado y has been mezcla el presente.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué había hecho Leo con la pasta.

choices.text: He had cooked it for too long.

title.en: Had done or had been doing
title.es: Había hecho o había estado haciendo

es: Formar el past perfect continuous (had been + -ing) y elegirlo frente a had + participio según se destaque la duración o el resultado.

teaching.en: We had been queuing for two hours when the doors finally opened.
teaching.es: Llevábamos dos horas haciendo cola cuando por fin se abrieron las puertas.
teaching.explanationEs: Had been + -ing + for: la actividad duró dos horas hasta ese momento.
segments: We had been queuing for two
hours when the doors finally opened.
teaching.audioText: We had been queuing for two hours when the doors finally opened.

teaching.en: Leo hadn't been sleeping well, so he was grumpy all day.
teaching.es: Leo no había estado durmiendo bien, así que estuvo de mal humor todo el día.
teaching.explanationEs: Negativa: hadn't been + -ing; explica el mal humor.
segments: Leo hadn't been sleeping well, so
he was grumpy all day.
teaching.audioText: Leo hadn't been sleeping well, so he was grumpy all day.

teaching.en: By noon Mia had finished two pages, so she took a short break.
teaching.es: Para el mediodía Mia había terminado dos páginas, así que hizo un breve descanso.
teaching.explanationEs: Had finished + cantidad: interesa el resultado (dos páginas), no el tiempo.
segments: By noon Mia had finished two pages,
so she took a short break.
teaching.audioText: By noon Mia had finished two pages, so she took a short break.

teaching.en: How long had you been queuing before the doors opened?
teaching.es: ¿Cuánto tiempo llevabas haciendo cola antes de que abrieran las puertas?
teaching.explanationEs: Pregunta de duración: How long + had + sujeto + been + -ing.
segments: How long had you been
queuing before the doors opened?
teaching.audioText: How long had you been queuing before the doors opened?

teaching.en: Sara had written four pages, but she had only been writing for an hour.
teaching.es: Sara había escrito cuatro páginas, pero solo llevaba una hora escribiendo.
teaching.explanationEs: Had written cuenta el resultado (four pages); had been writing mide el tiempo.
segments: Sara had written four pages, but she
had only been writing for an hour.
teaching.audioText: Sara had written four pages, but she had only been writing for an hour.

prompt.es: Completa: «Mia no había estado durmiendo bien, así que estaba de mal humor.»

answer.text: hadn't been

feedback.es: La negativa del past perfect continuous es hadn't been + -ing: Mia hadn't been sleeping.

hint.es: Es negativa: primero el auxiliar con not y después la palabra que precede al -ing.

title.es: El partido que casi no se juega

es: Leer un relato con saltos atrás y separar la causa previa, el incidente y el desenlace para ordenar los hechos en una cronología.

teaching.en: The referee inspected the pitch at half past three because it had been raining since morning.
teaching.es: El árbitro inspeccionó el campo a las tres y media porque había estado lloviendo desde la mañana.
teaching.explanationEs: La línea principal va en pasado simple (inspected); la causa previa, en had been.
segments: The referee inspected the pitch at half past
three because it had been raining since morning.
teaching.audioText: The referee inspected the pitch at half past three because it had been raining since morning.

teaching.en: There were puddles everywhere, and the workers had been cleaning the pitch for hours.
teaching.es: Había charcos por todas partes y los trabajadores llevaban horas limpiando el campo.

segments: There were puddles everywhere, and the workers
had been cleaning the pitch for hours.
teaching.audioText: There were puddles everywhere, and the workers had been cleaning the pitch for hours.

when they heard the final might be postponed.

segments: The final was supposed to start at four,
but it began at five past five.
teaching.audioText: The final was supposed to start at four, but it began at five past five.

teaching.en: Before the referee decided to wait, both teams had already arrived.

segments: Before the referee decided to wait,

hint.es: Es la causa previa del relato: una actividad que ya venía ocurriendo.

origin.text: The city final was supposed to start at four. It had been raining since morning, and the workers had been cleaning the pitch for hours, but there were still puddles everywhere. At half past three the referee inspected the pitch. The fans had been queuing outside for an hour, and both teams had already arrived. For a moment, everyone thought the final would be postponed. The referee decided to wait. At half past four the rain stopped, the sun came out, and the final began at five past five. Carlos's team won two to one.

hint.es: Es el incidente del relato: está en pasado simple.

title.es: El malentendido de la fiesta sorpresa

es: Aclarar un malentendido reconstruyendo lo anterior con had y had been, justificando decisiones y respondiendo a un reproche.

teaching.en: Sara thought her friends had forgotten her birthday, but they had been planning a surprise.
teaching.es: Sara pensó que sus amigos habían olvidado su cumpleaños, pero llevaban tiempo preparando una sorpresa.
teaching.explanationEs: Lo que Sara pensó es anterior a pensar: had forgotten; la preparación duró: had been planning.
segments: Sara thought her friends had forgotten her birthday,
but they had been planning a surprise.
teaching.audioText: Sara thought her friends had forgotten her birthday, but they had been planning a surprise.

teaching.en: Leo couldn't explain why he had been so busy because it was a secret.

segments: Leo couldn't explain why he had been
